stories.title: Marines want to move Camp Lejeune armory off paper and into the web
stories.why: A new solicitation for a SDVOSB contract also leans on the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul deviation instead of the standard FAR.

stories.title: Spain signs off on $6.3 billion budget for joint MRTT buy with Poland
stories.why: Poland’s minister of national defense said today that “at least” seven aircraft will be purchased, with his country receiving four by 2030.

stories.title: Aiming to turn ‘every device into a source,’ Cellebrite launches made-for-the-military data extraction kit
stories.why: The Israeli firm’s new C-TEK product triages data from mobile phones, SIM cards, computers, drones and other portable media.

stories.title: Raytheon, Boeing Secure $766M Air Force Contracts for B-52 Modernization
stories.why: Raytheon will handle AN/APQ-188 radar work, while Boeing will deliver bomb rack modernization system kits for the B-52.

stories.title: Parsons Subsidiary SealingTech Lands $750M USCYBERCOM JCHK Production OTA
stories.why: Parsons subsidiary SealingTech has booked a potential five-year, $750 million USCYBERCOM OTA for Joint Cyber Hunt Kit production.

stories.title: DHS Unveils Plans for Follow-On OneStream Systems Integrator BPA
stories.why: DHS plans to compete a follow-on $100 million OneStream systems integrator BPA, with award anticipated in the second quarter of FY27.

stories.title: Army moves cloud management under its Cyber Command
stories.why: Moving ECMA away from the Army's chief information officer aims to more closely integrate cloud management and cyber defenses.

stories.title: Air Force awards $100M production deal for AI-enabled readiness platform
stories.why: The Air Force is moving its fragmented scheduling, training and readiness systems into a single enterprise platform known as the Aerospace Readiness Enterprise...
